name: Brotherhood of Hops: Strange Reunion
text: Brotherhood of hops strikes again! Together with our Slovenian brothers Lobik we brewed this crossover IPA. Juicy and hoppy, but malty and bitter.

name: High Voltage
text: Get Shocked by FlavorBrewed with the High Voltage yeast, this beer channels the electrifying energy of AC/DC's anthem in every sip. The High Voltage yeast ferments at higher temperatures, just like Bon Scott's vocals soar on the high notes.

name: Bitter Peaks
text: As I managed to pass that last hindrance,I finally could see them, tall and sharp,stood there as a remembrance of somebetter and joyful times.

name: Hill 438
text: American IPA brewed with experimental HBC 438 hops

name: Hop Expedition: Yakima American IPA
text: Join our journey through the Yakima Valley and Perrault Farms with this classic American IPA! Brewed with a blend of new-age hops like Dynaboost Citra and HBC 638 alongside the trusted Simcoe and Cryo Amarillo, this IPA delivers a bold bitterness with a modern twist.

name: The Racoon
text: It's a twist between West Coast Ipa and East Coast Ipa.Simple base grain bill with Juicy liquid yeast, higher bitterness, and DDH with Simcoe Cryo, Strata, and HBC 586.We call this Mountain Ipa

name: Square Hammer
text: Upon the first strike,The land will tremble,Upon the second strike,Liquid Gold will be assembled.

name: Juggler IPA
text: First collaboration beer in Circus Hoppy Carnival! Maskeron chose first station to be our brewery. Other two more collaboration beers will be brewed in Slovenia and Serbia. Strata takes place as leading hops along with Mosaic Incognito and Nelson Sauvin. Stratastic IPA!

name: IPA 66
text: 66 metars = 66 IBUsOur IPA is dedicated to Zagreb's funicular - a world's shortest wire rail used for public transport.It's length, 66 meters, shares same number with IBU of our IPA. Enjoy "riding on" Mosaic, Cascade and Chinook!

name: Stay Hopdrated
text: A second beer dedicated to hikers and to all people who like being somewhere in nature.It is always good to stay hydrated during hikes, climbing, walking or cycling. But even better, we suggest to stay hopdrated with enough hops! This IPA is truely full of hops, thanks to amazing duo - Galaxy and Idaho7.Tropical, citrusy, stonefruits and bit spicy.Stay hydrated! Stay hopdrated!This is why we brew!

name: Nivelator IPA
text: The Nivellation - brewing process which is rarely mentioned, but highly important! It's a fantastic mixture of quality control and philosophy. The person has to be loud and noisy to be a successful Nivelator. The Nivelator speaks only random thread of thoughts. Cheers to you Glava!!!

name: C4
text: IPA made with 4 hops. Chinook, Citra, Centennial and Cascade.

name: I Promise You
text: "I promise you" is a most common phrase these days as we are approaching election days. We are very amused, also feeling like sheep when we hear all candidates saying what better will they do if they will be elected, or their promises and weird statements. Floating trams? International stadium? Cancer vaccine factory? ACI marine at Jarun lake? Doubling saleries and creating new jobs? Paving all hiking routes? No really, their imagination and promises are limitless!So, we also PROMISE YOU something, but that's only a great beer.'I Promise You' is a modern american IPA, clean, tasty and smooth, packed with citrusy and spicy aromas and flavors. Easy drinkable with ABV 6,7.This is why we brew!

name: Goblet Dragonfly
text: A fantastic collab brew for our friends from Goblet!Dragonfly is fruited NEIPA brewed with mango and pineapple, Citra, Simoce and Saaaaaabro - a hoppy tropical bomb! Pineapple express with fruity hopkick, superhazy looking, yet crushable IPA!Enjoy!

name: Death By IBU
text: Our second collaboration with our friend from Maskeron. It is a true west coast double IPA - citrusy, piney and caramel notes. Super drinkable, super hoppy! This beer is just awesome!We used cryo hops and incognito hop extract to maximized hop aroma and flavour. Hoppy beers always drink fresh. And in large amounts :DBest beer in Croatia 2020 (Ratebeer)

name: ThroaTTwisteR
text: Juicy and dry DIPA, collaboration with ThroaTTwisteR band from Zagreb.

name: Death By IBU (5th Edition)
text: It's that time of year when death rises on the West Coast!5th edition of the collaboration version of #DeathByIbu with our dear friend Maskeron is back. And it's deadly good.As always, we have played with the recipe a bit. Not much, just enough for a small twist. This year we add some of the Mosaic Spectrum hop extract from BarthHaas X for an extra hoppy kick. Seems to be a home run!

name: Death By IBU (7th Edition)
text: Our 7th collab edition of Death by IBU with Maskeron brewery!This year we brew DBI with lots of cryo, flex and incognito form of hops, and special new one - Yakima's hyperboost for even more hoppy flavors.Baaaaaaam!

name: Hazy Double IPA #03
text: Tropical fruitbowl with aromas of mango, pineapple, coconut and guava.

name: Stratosaurus
text: Zmajska pivovara was founded on March 8th 2013. This year we celebrate our birthday with double IPA.

name: Death By IBU (6th Edition)
text: Our 6th collab edition of Death by IBU with Maskeron brewery!Even more hops in form of cryo, spectrum, flex and incognito. We are happy to say this is a killer IPA! Hoppy AF!

name: Gargoyle Gala
text: Traditional birthday double IPA.Hops: YCH702 Citra, HBC586 Cryo, Motueka, Citra, Ekuanot, El Dorado

name: Double Claw
text: An explosion of aromas and flavors! Strong beer with aromas of fresh grapefruit, pineapple and tropical fruit. An enviable amount of alcohol, double dry hopped with El Dorado, Mosaic and Simocoe. A real hop fest!

name: Hop Tornado
text: Turbulent hop majesty HOP TORNADO! The name is everything, and this beer is also guaranteed by two abbreviations that describe it: DDH DIPA, as well as the expected high percentage of alcohol (ABV: 8.3%). It bears the name of a weather disaster, but surely this Tornado will engrave your memory as a happy moment!

name: Hazy Double IPA: Tropical Juice Explosion
text: Juicy Pineapple, Passion Fruit & ripe Mango, with distinctive Gooseberry & Lychee notes. A celebration of 3 amazing hops: Nelson Sauvin (NZ) gives its mineral white wine notes, Galaxy (AU) turns the juice up to 10 and gives a piney resinous edge, and the new experimental HBC1019 from Yakima Valley (USA) adds layers of Peach, Melon & Apricot.

name: Urnebes
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: DDH Juicy Double NEIPACollab with our old friend - Beckers craft brewery

name: Temporary Overload
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: As the name suggests, if you want to taste a temporary overload of hops, this is the go-to beer. Double dry-hopped with Galaxy, Citra and Mosaic hops.

name: Efreet Vizier
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: We continued with series of beer labels with mythical creatures and legends. For those who spent their childhood playing strategy games like 'Heroes of Might and Magic' will surely recognize inspiration for this beer label.Tasting this liquid tropical bomb won't give you fire resistance and you won't learn how to fly, but it will fill your mouth with citrus and stone fruit flavors. Lot's of stone fruits!Brewed and dryhopped with huge amount of Peacharine hops, aside with Citra and Nectarone. Cheers!

name: Beach Bar
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: New England Double IPA brewed with Azacca, Amarillo and Mosaic with the addition of experimental HBC 630 hops.

name: Hibernation
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: Frozen for eons, but never forgotten. You thought they'll lose aroma through time, but they only got stronger! Powerful and vengeful, these hops can't wait to burst through the aluminum pod and kick you in the face with that hibernated hoppy aroma!!     Hazy Double NEIPA with Azacca, Galaxy, Idaho 7 and Citra hops.

name: Lunatic
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: Lunatic je Double NEIPA, kojeg smo skuhali u suradnji s našim poznatim homebrewerom i hmeljnim ambasadorom Nikom Čučkovićem aka Maskeron.Pogađate, Lunatic je apsolutna hmeljna bomba: velike količine novijih hmeljeva zaslužne su za arome i okuse tropskog i citrusnog voća. Suho je hmeljen do razine neprozirnosti, a protutežu gorčini daju pšenični i zobeni slad zbog kojih je pivo svilenkastog i punog okusa.

name: Hopblind
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: Stuck in the shady room,with no space to move.Creepy voices in the void,the chilly plague of the former spoil.Should I stop, should I be worried?Hell no, Hopblind will keep me warm!

name: Basilisk's Gaze
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: We continued with series of beer labels with mythical creatures and legends. For those who spent their childhood playing strategy games like 'Heroes of Might and Magic' will surely recognize inspiration for this beer label.Looking into the eye of the Basilisk will cause instantaneous thirst, however, even catching a glance of it in a reflection will cause crawing for beer or whimper effect! Beware!Brewed with Galaxy, Mosaic and Citra, this is a hoppy beast!Double NEIPA, double the fun!

name: Daylight Vampire
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: Daylight Vampire is thirsty for some hops!!!This is our new Double New England IPA with my friends form Prva Makarska Pivovara.We brewed soft, creamy, thick, hazylicious Neipa packed with 2 Lots of best Strata on the market.One is super Dank and the other one is Fruity combined with Masaic Lupomax, Enigma and Simcoe Cryo.Special liquid yeast from Yeast Flow, (London III)Man....hoppy vampires will go nuts. Watch out !!thanks to Matija aka Trollenium Art for Illustration

name: Hazy Double IPA #09
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: Big waves of citrus and ripe stone fruits. Packed with Mosaic, Sabro & Amarillo hops.

name: Daylight Dracula
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: Daylight Dracula is our second Double Neipa in this series after Daylight Vampire.This Hazy Double New England Dipa is brewed with all NZ Hops and not just any NZ hops but with NECTARON, RIWAKA and MOUTERE.....you welcome !!!

name: Phantoms of the Plains
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: Phantoms from Zbir and Nova Runda keep the plains untouched by a human hand, so they can harvest all the goodness for themselves. The result of the harvest is remarkable Double NEIPA single hopped with all variants of Mosaic - T-90, BBC, Incognito, and Spectrum.

name: Nakatomi Tower Situation
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: Nakatomi Tower is on fire, and the only solution to contain the damage is a combination of Sabro, Citra, Mosaic, and HBC 472 hops! #YippeeKiYay

name: Hazy Double IPA #07
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: Full-bodied, soft and juicy with heavy notes of Tangerine, Mango & CoconutPacked with Talus, HBC472, Citra and Simcoe

name: Hazy Double IPA #11
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: An East Coast DIPA cranked up to 10 with massive notes of Melon, Coconut & Papaya

name: Hazy Double IPA #01
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: Peach, melon, passion fruit and tangerine aromas. Packed with Galaxy, Citra und Azacca Cryo hops.

name: East Coast Double IPA
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: Super soft and full-bodied. Luscious notes of Cherries, Candy & Coconut from the HBC630, Talus & Citra hops. Made with our Canadian friends, Willibald Farm Distillery & Brewery

name: Double New England IPA (Barrier)
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: Massive Hazy with 3 classic hops: El Dorado, Ekuanot & Simcoe. Juicy & Complex with notes of Berries, Peach & Tropical Fruits. Made with our mates from New York

name: Veil of Shadow
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: PHANTASM, Imperial New England Ipa with Phantasm and Waimea in WHP. DDH with Superdelic and Krush.

name: Hop Pot
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: A collaboration beer with our friends from Romania - Bereta!During a brewday we were also cooking a nice big pot of goulash, a stew of meat with gnocci, from where we drain our label idea. It was a super tasty goulash, nicely spicy and all was gone in minutes...Just like you'll be done with this double NEIPA.Guys from Bereta and us wanted to experiment with some new hop products and hop varieties from New Zealand... So we used Mega Motueka (Motueka + phantasm blend) and Super Sauvin (Nelson Sauvin + phantasm blend) and Nelson SubZero Hop Kief for extra hoppy juicyness! Combined with Citra hop background, it has tropical, citrusy, sweet-grape aroma with danky notes. Yummy!We love it so much!

name: Cosmic Collision
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: When you put your favorite hops all together you get Cosmic Collision. HBC 586 Cryo, Nelson Sauvin Sub Zero Hop Kief from Freestyle Hops and good old Mosaic.This Double NEIPA was brewed in collaboration with the mythical Ophiussa Brewing from Portugal.

name: Your Mama Don't Dance
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: The second DIPA brewed with Voss Kveik yeast. As a hop background here are Mosaic, Cashmere, Citra and Amarillo hops!

name: Double New England IPA (Vocation)
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: Our second hoppy collab with the Hebden Bridge legends. Super smooth and silky with a huge hop load delivering intense Melon and Passion Fruit.

name: Hopzinga!
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: Scissors cuts paper, paper covers rock, rock crushes lizard, lizard poisons Spock, Spock smashes scissors, scissors decapitates lizard, lizard eats paper, paper disproves Spock, Spock vaporizes rock, and as it always has, rock crushes scissors.'But in the end a great beer destroys them all ?Double fruited, double dry hopped double IPA with 8% ABV.Citrusy, tropical and very juicy, ascending pineapple aroma with light sweetness and a hint of fruit's tartness. In this IPA we added mango and pineapple to even more increase fruity juiciness! This is why we brew!BEER READY for more!

name: Beerserker Rage
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: We found inspiration for a new double NEIPA in Scandinavian mythology. Immune to fear, furiously violent and out of control, bersekers were powerful warriors. Just like this double IPA, fearless and untainted.We definitely have started mini-series of beer labels with mythical creatures and legends. For those who spent their childhood playing strategy games like 'Heroes of Might and Magic' will surely recognize inspiration for beer labels to come.. We hyped this imperial IPA with amazing Nectaron hops, powered up with Citra cryo form and Simcoe hops. Tropical punch with citrusy flavours, full bodied and very silky!THIS IS WHY WE BREW!

name: Djinn Sultan
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: We continued with series of beer labels with mythical creatures and legends. For those who spent their childhood playing strategy games like 'Heroes of Might and Magic' will surely recognize inspiration for this beer label.Djiin cast his spells 'Bless of Topaz' and 'Mosaic's Fortune' into whirpool hops additon combined with 'Magical bloodlust of Riwaka' in dry hopping, making this double NEIPA very tropical and bit spicy!Enjoy in this magical enchanced hoppy DNEIPA!THIS IS WHY WE BREW!

name: Hazy Double IPA #10
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: Juicy and refreshing with a complex and resinous hop character of soft fruits & berries

name: Plima - Double IPA
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: Big, juicy and full bodied. Smooth hazy with waves of Citrus, Berry & Coconut

name: Hoppy Aid
text: In this sorrowful time, we stand with the people of Ukraine, and that's why 1€ of a purchased can will be donated to a charity organization to provide additional help for the people in Ukraine.

name: Cloud Lane
text: One of the nine European breweries to first use and test a new hop variety called SUPERDELIC.Excited new trippy entry from NZ hops.Along with NECTARON and dash of BRU -1.YOU WELCOME.....

name: Hoppy Brewday 2021
text: 7 years ago we released our flagship American Pale Ale - Nova Runda APA. It's time to celebrate those 7 years with a special limited juicy brewski.

name: Solar Haze
text: Bright, solar light full of hops - Galaxy, Idaho 7, Mosaic & Simcoe!

name: Liquid Feast
text: LIQUID FEAST,When you get hands on EGGERS HOPS in the EU it's a Liquid Feast, nothing less. So excited and proud to present this special batch with EGGERS famous RIWAKA for the first time in these parts of the Europe.My favorite juice strain WHC SATURATED for a full body, rich mouth feel. DDH with EGGERS RIWAKA and touch of HBC1019 CRYO hops.Let's the feast begin!

name: A Nightmare In Celine Street
text: At first glance, it looks just like your average brewery, but it's everything but regular. Our brewers are using a special kind of equipment in the brewing process, do you dare to check it out?NEIPA with Mosaic, Talus and Sabro!

name: Balkan Can
text: Can Can is a physically challenging dance, but it may become even dangerous if a Balkan crowd is involved. In this case, it is, and this Balkan Can is orchestrated by 2 brewers - Bulgarian Beer Bastards and Croatian Nova Runda. The main dancers in this Balkan Can are Talus, Simcoe, Mosaic and Cashmere hops!

name: Jester's Opus
text: Mad Doctor loves hops so much that every experiment must contain hops in it. Talus, Citra, and of course, Jester and Opus are key ingredients in this experiment!!

name: Numunuu
text: CLASH OF THE TITANS ARE BACK!2025 Series is clash between USA and NZ hops.Same base different hops.Numunuu, USA team is:Mosaic, Krush, Simcoe Cryo DDHChoose your team and enjoy the beers!#brothers in roots!!!

name: Strataspheric Discharge
text: All those hops concentrated in the atmosphere needed one powerful discharge. Strata is falling from the sky!!!

name: Small Batch Series: 30 NEIPA
text: NEIPA brewed with Mosaic, Talus and Sabro hops. Happy 1st birthday to Ambasada beer shop!

name: TCB - Taking Care of Business
text: Rhapsody of hops backed by Verdant yeast.

name: Resolution 2022 NEIPA
text: The goals for 2022:1. Set up the Brewery Taproom2. Organize again the #BeerUPZG and Open Days3. Release a new beer style4. Put more focus on the Barrel-Aged Program

name: I'm An Idiot
text: They couldn't have arrived at our Birthday Beer Bash, but at least we managed to mix some hops and malts together. The final result is this smooth and fruity NEIPA.

name: Juicy Junkie
text: Best of Show Hrvatsko homebrew prvenstvo 2019

name: Tactical Five
text: The fruitiest team trained by the finest hop farms is entering the court. Citra and Chinook are playing the guard formations, Zappa and Ekuanot are forming the forward positions, and the dunk master, Cashmere, is here to cover the center position.

name: King Garoo
text: New England IPA with Australian hops - Enigma, Eclipse, Vic Secret and Galaxy.Attention all units, attention all units!!There's a King Garoo on the loose!!Could you repeat that again, sir?I said     THERE'S A FREAKIN' KING GAROO ON THE LOOSE!!!

name: Bone Thundersnow
text: A superhazy NEIPA brewed with Krush and Peacharine hops!Burst tropical and stonefruit flavors with danky notes!

name: Hop Expedition: Yakima Juicy IPA
text: A New England-style brew inspired by our visit to Yakima Valley and Perrault Farms. This hazy delight utilizes a unique hop combination featuring new-age Dynaboost Citra, HBC 638, HBC 1019, alongside Cryo Ekuanot.

name: Lucid Visions
text: Day dreaming of a winter holiday to a tropical island destination from behind your desk…Lucid Visions is our latest IPA, focused on the distinctive stone fruit and tropical flavours made famous by Mosaic hops, for this brew we’ve layered Mosaic with a healthy addition of El Dorado and BRU 1, to intensify the pungent stone fruit, tropical and pineapple flavours.Oat and Wheat malt help give this NEIPA a smooth and silky mouthfeel, with medium bitterness to help intensify the juice like qualities.

name: Cosmic Cruiser
text: In the distant future, the interstellar cruiser soared through the Milky Way, its body equipped with advanced warp drives for traveling between hops. Its intrepid crew marveled at the cosmic beauty of each hop, navigating through asteroid fields and nebulas while chasing their ultimate destination.New England IPA brewed with HBC 586, El Dorado, and Mosaic hops.

name: ZugZwang
text: In this playground of chess, a move is forced. The pawn, helpless, steps closer to its fall. With every turn, the walls of defeat grow tall. No escape from this web of strategic force. Each piece, entrapped, bends to its master's will. Forced into zugzwang, surrendering their skill.NEIPA brewed with Eclipse, Galaxy, Vista, and El Dorado hops!

name: Hit By Lightning And Bitten By A Cobra
text: How to tell you're a badass without telling you're a badass??

name: Kolaboracija 2
text: Second collaboration by the forerunners of the Croatian craft beer revolution. Fruited NEIPA with large quantity of Guava and Passion fruit.

name: Hornet's Feast
text: As the sun set on the brewery, a menacing buzz could be heard in the distance. Suddenly, a swarm of hornets descended upon the taproom, seeking out the sweet nectar of the freshly crafted beer.NEIPA brewed with Lemondrop, Mosaic, and Citra hops.

name: Resolution 2023 NEIPA
text: It's a new year, but also, new resolutions! NEIPA brewed with Talus, Comet, Mosaic and Citra hops.

name: Crazy Kvejki
text: When you ferment and dry hop in same day - that is not usual thing in brewing. Main reason is norwegian special yeast that can transform wort into beer in only 24 hours. "Supernatural" yeast is for sure, it must be from out of space!If that is not crazy enough, we added crazy amount of Southern passion, Sabro and Idaho7 hops(23g/L) just for dry hopping.Passionfruit, peach, apricots, tropical, coconut, orange peel, touch of tartness, spicy, citrusy are just layers of complexity in the aroma and flavour.Crazy? Yeah, crazy for sure!

name: First Round: Fight!
text: Our good friends from Budapest, First Craft Beer, joined us to brew this New England IPA! A combo of Rakau, Galaxy, Motueka, Citra, and YCH 303 Trial Blend was used in this 6.1% ABV NEIPA!

name: Cyclone
text: Pale base, huge amount of oats.English yeast strain.Dry hop during fermentation.Biotransformation.Add a lot more hops.Make it swirl.

name: How Yes No
text: Yeah right, How Yes No, or a little bit of tomorrow? Should I throw an eye to check which form fits perfectly in the sentence? Yes, broken words are never meant to be broken.

name: Hazy IPA Hop Showcase #04 Galaxy
text: Huge passionfruit and peach aromas with citrus and pineapple in support of this Galaxy edition of our Hazy IPA.

name: El Guerrero Resaca
text: Third luchador in our Lucha Libre series. This one is armed with Sabro, Simcoe, Azzaca, Mosaic and Strata hops. La resaca no es mi debilidad, esa es mi fuerza!

name: So Hard To Share
text: Kinda like your favorite toy, you liked to play with it, but you didn't want to share it with others. You are now older, wiser (maybe), and your new favorite toy is a beer - it's so hard to share it with others, we know.

name: Hazy IPA Hop Showcase #05 Sabro
text: We marry Sabro with two of our favourite staples, Simcoe and Azacca for a Hazy IPA bursting with pineapple, apricot, berry and coconut aromas.

name: New England IPA: Spectrum Showcase
text: Basqueland (Hernani, just outside San Sebastian, Spain) Collab: 6.8%We love Basqueland; especially their big Hazies so we came together to make one and showcase the new hop product Spectrum (a natural hop extraction). Supercharged with Galaxy, Bru-1, Citra and Mosiac this is soft and smooth; juicy and tropical

name: Dream Valley
text: Brewing with Yakima Chief's finest hops,Chinook, Talus, Sabro, Idaho 7 Cryo Hopsmade this beer full of aromas and our hearts full of pride for making this tasteful collab with our beer brothers&associates.

name: Perfection Valley
text: Do you think it's easy digging and traveling through all that sand, hunting those 2 legged primates? It ain't, especially when the tremors trigger your anxiety! I have a sore throat, so just let me finally relax on the surface and enjoy a cold one!!!NEIPA brewed with Talus, Amarillo, and Mosaic hops!

name: El Tormenta
text: Cerveza afrutada y jugosa. Por primera vez utilizamos levadura de jugo Imperial para expresar notas más afrutadas en esta IPA. Combinación de lúpulo en la nueva cerveza: Equinoccio, Agrios, Lobo De Estiria, Calista, Crio Citrico!!

27 godina je prošlo od kada smo 22. prosinca 1994. ideju da ljubitelji piva zaslužuju bolje pivo pretočili u stvarnost! Zajedno smo uz pivo proveli bezbroj prekrasnih trenutaka, stvorili bezbroj osmijeha i sjećanja. Bilo je izazovnih i nesigurnih trenutaka no ti trenuci su nas samo učinili jačima i sigurnijima u to da nas čeka još puno više prekrasnih zajedničkih trenutaka u budućnosti!Kako tradicija nalaže, za danas smo vam pripremili rođendansko pivo 27 kako bismo zajedno mogli nazdraviti. Ova prekrasna NEIPA s 6,7% alkohola i IBU 35 je nama možda najbolje pivo ove godine, a svakako je i najdraže!

name: Oblivion Bloom
text: OBLIVION BLOOMNew luscious New England Ipa built on a foundation of oats, wheat and chit malt for a pillowy mouth feel.Expressive yeast strain Thermotolerant, with Mango and Guava aroma.DDH with MOTUEKA, TALUS and HBC1019 CRYO for extra tropical flavor.Bring On 2025 brew year!!!

name: Resolution 2024 NEIPA
text: Resolutions for 2024! NEIPA brewed with HBC 630, Motueka and Columbus hops

name: DA-IPA
text: Hazy? Hoppy? Hell yeah! Columbus, Citra and Simcoe are band members in this ho(i)ppy van full of fruity instruments!

name: Perpetual Scaffolding
text: Oh, perpetual scaffolding,A symbol of hope and progression,May you remain steadfast and strong,And guide us on towards ascension.

name: Calamari Afterparty
text: Polish brewery, Browar Stu Mostow, jumped in their car and drove 8 hours to Croatia so we could brew this NEIPA. This Calamari isn't stuffed with a regular ham and cheese, this Calamari is stuffed with El Dorado, Citra and Simcoe hops!

name: Juicetopia
text: Escape to Juicetopia, your perfect summer hideout! Enjoy in the shade of YCH 603 TRIAL Cryo, Ekuanot, Eclipse, and Strata hops, while chilling on a beach of this juicy island vacation!

name: Kolaboracija
text: Brewed in collaboration with Nova Runda and Varionica brewery, other two croatian craft beer scene pioneers.

name: Carnival Macabre
text: What a tropical bomb!Bursting pineapple, ripe stone fruits, citrusy with bit danky spicy touch. All that from new hop we used - Nectaron!This great New Zealand variety will intrique every hophead.We are amazed how Nectaron turned out and emerged very well with Idaho7 and Citra hops in this hoppy juicy IPA ?

name: Science Butch
text: Grab a piece from this,Grab a piece from there,It's easier when it sleeps,Just take it all the way,But once it takes a leap,Be sure to run away!NEIPA brewed with Galaxy, HBC 630, Citra and Mosaic hops!

name: Midnight Flyer
text: Catch a one-way ticket to Flavortown with Midnight Flyer NEIPA. This hazy New England IPA is your late-night copilot, bursting with juicy citrus and tropical hops that keep the party going all night!

name: Mata Kai Kutu
text: CLASH OF THE TITANS ARE BACK!2025 Series is clash between NZ and USA hops.Same base different hops.Mata Kai Kutu, NZ team is:Eggers Riwaka, Nectaron and Motueka DDHChoose your team and enjoy the beers!#brothers in roots!!!

name: Log, Stack, And Two Smoking Sliders
text: A Collab brew with our friends from Sarajevo - Pi Brewery and Brko Brewery, a.k.a. Brew Brothers. It's a New Zealand Mountain IPA brewed with Motueka, Nelson Sauvin, Riwaka, Pacifica, and NZ Cascade hops.

name: Liquid Feast Edition 2026
text: New England IPA, or should we call it Kiwi Hazy? We have a beast combo here, Kiwi Best, perhaps.Riwaka from Eggers, if you know what I mean, and new star Peacharine. This is like Al Pacino and Robert De Niro in a hazy thriller full of smooth bodies and tropical thunder.The Juice Is Real!!

name: Hop Expedition: Nelson #1 NZIPA
text: Waimea, Nelson Sauvin, Nectaron, and Riwaka hops are paving the road to all our New Zealand suppliers. From Pikimai Hops to Freestyle Hops and NZ hops, the road has never been more hoppy!

name: Hop Expedition: Nelson #2 NZIPA
text: New Zealand IPA brewed with Riwaka, Nectaron Cryo, Nelson Sauvin, Peachtarine, and Manilita hops.

name: A Doomed Odyssey
text: Traveling through distant planets in search of the portal which should teleport them to a land of richness and prosperity, but in the end, that land doesn't look as expected, right?Mountain IPA brewed with HBC 472, Comet, Simcoe, Mosaic and Chinook hops!

name: Fantom 30
text: Mutno je zlatne boje, svježih tropskih i začinskih mirisa, a sedam vrsta hmeljeva daju mu arome tropskog voća i juicy okus. Lijepo balansirano pivo, izrazito pitko s blagom gorčinom i slatkoćom u pozadini.

name: Triple IPA #01
text: Soft, full-bodied and intensely aromatic with sweet Mandarin, Melon, Pineapple and Coconut aromas

name: Pink Guava Triple IPA
text: One Drop (Sydney, Australia) Collab: 10%Our original Head Brewer Nick now runs this growing operation and is pumping out some brilliant and innovative beers. This enormous TIPA is crammed with Sabro, Amarillo & Citra then generously fruited with Australian Pink Guava for an extra fruity edge

name: Triple IPA #02
text: Soft and juicy with fruity waves of Citrus, Mango, Pineapple and Passion Fruit

name: Triple IPA
text: SIXTH BIRTHDAY COLLAB BREWHoppy beast with heavy notes of Mango, Passion Fruit & Coconut Packed with Citra, Strata & Sabro hops

name: Hop'd As F***
text: A 3rd hazy IPA in our "Triple threesome IPA series" is Triple New England IPA."Triple threesome" is a new project that pushes the limits on the hop amount in beer! It is all about hops and silky texture in your mouth. We will present three hazy IPAs, use three varieties of hops per beer and three different yeasts - Triple threesome includes hazy IPA, Double IPA and Triple IPA!HOP'D AS F... is the showcase of Medusa, Sabro and El Dorado hops! These are neomexicanus genes!Tropical and citrusy bomb of hops, stonefruits and dankish, hint of cocconuts. Absolute beauty with 9.6abv dangerously drinkable. Hopped more that 40g/L,  truely this is a hoppy explosion.For our 3rd IPA we choose an amazing yeast, Voss Kveik from Lalbrew.

name: Cybeerpunk: Big Trouble In Hop City
text: Take me to year 2122...Cybeerpunk serie is a new project imagined as triple IPA series, comic based spectacle presented by us and creative Yan Kamov design studio.Hot babes, katanas, lasers, guns, neon lights, greedy villain with evil master plan to steel Cybeer Hop, and of course, a heroe to rescue the Hop City...Find out about a plot, characters and other details in comic based serie on our social networks (IG and FB).First TRIPLE IPA - BIG TROUBLE IN HOP CITY is hazy TIPA loaded with Citra, Idaho7 and new star amongst hops - Riwaka! Grepefruit, lemony, orange peel, stonefruits and spicy aromas!Stay tuned for new TIPA in Cybeerpunk serie...to be continued...

name: Cybeerpunk: Brewpocalypse
text: Cybeerpunk series is coming to an end...It's a unique project imagined as triple IPAs series, comic based spectacle presented by us and creative Yan Kamov design studio.We will release 3rd and last edition of Cybeerpunk comic so you guys can read it as whole.It is year 2124 and Hop City is on the brink of an apocalypse...Brewpocalypse, to be exact.Hazy Triple IPA is loaded with Citra, Rakau and Nelson Sauvin. Tropical bomb!Super drinkable beast with 9.8 abv, beware and rehydrate yourself properly. This is why we brew!

name: Cybeerpunk: Fist of Doom
text: The second part of our fantastic saga is here. And again, it reappears as a double combo!'Cybeerpunk: Fist of doom' it's the name of our new fantastic 'triple NEIPA' but also a new part of our collaboration Cybeerpunk comic. Yan Kamov Graphic Design we salute you.So guys, buckle up and enjoy the exciting story - the return of Hop Doom now reinforced with a new evil sidekick! Will Keg Pitcher and Aley Haze manage to save Hop City one more time? There is so much going on!This is definitely one of our favorite projects... having a comic is so bloody cool. Pairing it with the beer it's just another dimension!'Fist Of Doom' is a triple New England IPA loaded with Citra cryo, Citra and experimental HBC 586 hops. This is why we brew!

name: Cerberus
text: We continued with series of beer labels with mythical creatures and legends. For those who spent their childhood playing strategy games like 'Heroes of Might and Magic' will surely recognize inspiration for this beer label.Brewed with Mosaic, Galaxy, Eukanot and Superdelic, burst tropical and citrusy flavours, with some stone fruits notes. Three-headed hellhound for a triple NEIPA!

name: Tropical Yeti
text: A lot of wheat malt, and a lot of hops! Comet, Nugget, Sabro and Simcoe are quartet which balance all that wheat goodness in this IPA.

name: Beckers Pale Ale
text: Pale ale koji slobodno može stati rame uz rame mnogim IPA-ma. Bogat hmeljem u čijoj kombinaciji do izražaja dolaze arome tropskog voća, ananasa, borovine i naranče a nalazi se na čvrstim sladnim temeljima za savšenu ravnotežu okusa.

name: Goblet Demon (2023 Edition)
text: GOBLET DEMON is a special batch for a prestigious craft beer store in Croatia. At the moment, Goblet is celebrating its 4th anniversary. A toast-worthy occasion, indeed! So, we brewed a Hazy Pale loaded with the best selection of different hops products. YCH TRIAL 603 were used in the whirlpool, followed by DDH with CITRA SPECTRUM, NECTARON T90, and MOTUEKA SUB ZERO HOP KIEF. It doesn’t get juicier than this. Enjoy this brew and raise a glass to the Goblet Beer Store!!!

name: Goblet Demon (2024 Edition)
text: Anniversary beer for Goblet Beer Store.This is Hazy Pale brewed with WHC Saturated yeast and triple dry hopped. First with Spectrum Eclipse, then with Citra Cryo and the cold last DH is Nelson Sauvin and Motueka T90.Happy 5th anniversary Goblet Demons!!!

name: Jam In the Van
text: Found some good spot on the way to rest after a long drive? Sorry dudes, there's no rest, grab your musical sticks and percussions, fans are expecting some wild party at the parking lot!

name: GOBLET DEMON 2025 EDITION
text: This beer is brewed to celebrate Goblet Beer Store's 6th birthday.The batch is DDH with a new hop variety PEACHARINE from a NZ FreeStyle, also featuring KRUSH CRYO, NELSON, and GALAXY Abstrax.Let's raise a glass to Goblet Beer Store!!!

name: THE LAST DANCE - MEDUSA
text: MEDUSA - NEOMEXICANUS single DHHomage to TODD BATESNot every hero wears a cape. Todd Bates was wearing his old straw hat back in the '90 while searching for the NEOMEXICANUS hops in New Mexico.Thanks to his and CLS FARM'S hard work in 2014 we got MEDUSA hops. First 100% native, wild, pure, American hops. After 10 years Medusa is no longer grown. This is The Last bag of Medusa hops, this is The Last beer with Medusa hops....This is THE LAST DANCE.

name: Glam Hazy Pale
text: GLAM BEER THERAPY is the first and true craft bar in the old town of Dubrovnik, home port of all my beers since my homebrew days.BATCH No:2Just a twist with the new hops.Second batch is Krush, Strata and Simcoe Abstrax.Batch No:1SOLD OUTit's time to open a summer season 2025 with a brand new hazy pale. Soft and silky mouthfeel from a pillowy body, vivid fruit character, and bold tropical flavors.DDH with KRUSH, CITRA AND COLUMBUS CRYO

name: Bard
text: DDH MOSACI CRYO, CITRA, EL DORADO

name: High Moon
text: Hazy New England PaleDDH with new hop VISTA 50% and 25% each of SABRO and TALUS.WHC yeast, Tropical Paradise.

name: Small Batch Series : 44 New England Pale Ale
text: Fruity and hoppy NE Pale Ale brewed with Citra, Mosaic, Lemondrop, and Cascade hops to celebrate the 2nd birthday of the beer shop Ambasada!

name: New England Pale Ale #09
text: Punchy Pale with heady Grapefruit & Melon aroma. Packed with Mosaic, Citra, Amarillo & Strata hops

name: Top Manager
text: Mosaic, Citra and Styrian Wolf are fruity ingredients in this New England pale ale. Modern twist to classic American pale ale, Top Manager is your Summer Go-To beer!

name: Beer Bash 2023
text: The 10th-year anniversary of the brewery deserves a special batch! This New Zealand Pale Ale symbolizes the last 10 years of beer innovation and creativity of our brewery!

name: Goblet Warrior
text: Goblet Warrior 2025 editionMountain Pale,DDH with ANCHOVY HOPS (first appearance in the EU) plus HBC 630 and Equanot Cryo.

name: Small Batch Series : 41 New Zealand Pale Ale
text: American Pale Ale brewed with Motueka and Nelson Sauvin hops

name: EVEN FLOW
text: XPA, another hazy monster when it comes to the hops selection - 5% alc full body, not sweet, easy drinking hazy extra pale ale.Riwaka went first in Biotransformation and then the dankest Strata lot ever produced 474.Kohia Nelson is third hops, well thanks to NZ FreeStyle we got a first-ever botanical hop. Mix T90 The Bruce hops (Nelson, Motueka, NZ Cascade and Wakatu) with dry NZ Passion Fruit powder mixed all together and palatalized in one.

name: Bummer!
text: Most of us are looking forward to the upcoming Christmas holidays... except maybe the Easter Bunny.Well, Bummer!It'll be easier to get through it with one beautiful imperial pastry porter. We explored the limits, both with body and drinkability, as well as with the absorption of large amounts of chocolate and vanilla. It's smooth and rich, just be careful - it's an 11,2% beast.This is why we brew!

name: Imperial Vanilla & Chocolate Porter
text: Our Chocolate & Vanilla Porter with more of all the good stuff.  Deep chocolate and dark malt aromas blend with Madagascan Vanilla with a huge silken body.

name: Into The Darkness
text: A big and bold Imperial Porter with coconut, aged for 15 months in a bourbon barrel that also aged Martinique rum. Pure romance.Big bodied, oily, and smooth, with the character of rum, wood, brown sugar, caramelized malt, some coffee, with a fine chocolate dip, and a coconut finish..A fantastic choice for these cold days that lead us into the darkness.This is why we brew!

name: Small Batch Series: 31 Barrel Aged Imperial Porter
text: Dark and oily Porter barrel-aged in Bourbon barrels.

name: Small Batch Series: 27 Imperial Porter
text: A complex and rich porter made with vanilla beans.

name: Imperial Flat White Coffee Porter
text: Our Flat White Coffee Porter with more of everything!  Deeply complex malts, married to chocolate, vanilla and coffee from our favorite roasters Cogito Coffee.

name: Upbeat Sour
text: Collaboration brew with Dogma brewery. Sour beer with apricot.Inspired by local folclore and apricot schnapps.

name: Imperial Blackberry, Blueberry & Raspberry Sour
text: Imperial lactose sour drowning in blueberries, raspberries and blackberries. With a hint of citrus.

name: Imperial Blueberry, Lemon & Vanilla Sour
text: Double-fruited kettle sour with fragrant Vanilla and zesty Lisbon lemons

name: Bunny Passion
text: What's your summer passion? - Passion fruit juice- Kettle sour- Hangover cure

name: Imperial Florida Weisse #06 - Prickly Pear, Pink Guava & Strawberry
text: Aromatic, tart and juicy triple-fruited Kettle Sour.

name: Smoothiesh: ...Fry-day!
text: Hipster Rhino asked a question: What day do chicken hate the most?And the answer has a Punk Chicken... Fry-day!Funny cause is fruit! We do love dad jokes...This time we have played with a super cool fruit - star fruit (croatian: karambola)Absolutely crazy stuff guys, it's like combination of pineapple, passion fruit, apricot and mango...and very sour, yammy.We added a lot of apple pure, and then twisted with cocconut. Crazy combination, properly sour, sweetish and super tasty! Tropical punch I am tellin' you Contain real fruit. Don't age. Keep in a refrigerator. Drink fresh. For best experience, gently rotate the can few times before you open it.# This is why we brew!

name: Smoothiesh: At the Second Hand Shop!
text: And the answer to parrot's question is here - At the second hand shop!Crazy good fruit combination, yummy!Mango, sour cherries and raspberry with chocolate brownies!Contains real fruit. Don't age. Keep in a refrigerator. Drink fresh. For best experience, gently rotate the can few times.THIS IS WHY WE BREW!

name: Smoothiesh: What Do Sharks Do For Fun?
text: It's time for another #smoothiesh sour from Smoothiesh sour series!Summer is just around a corner - it's perfect time for delicious sourness!Again, dad's joke is here and this time Mr.Pimp the Doplphin asked a question: "What do sharks do for fun?"Crazy amount of fruit is present again, we could say it is a tropical bomb, guys. Yammmy! Passion fruit with apricots and orange is a crazy fruit combination, true sour kick to refresh those hot days. And vanilla for true pastry twist. Delicious!This is why we brew!Contains real unfermented fruit. Drink fresh. Don't age. Store in refrigerator.Gently rotate can few times before you open it for full experince.

name: Smoothiesh: What Do You Call A Fast Llama?
text: There's a new llama in town. This one won't spit at you. Just love and peace.This time our 'Smoothiesh series' brings you a new heavily fruited sour - 'What do you call a fast llama?'. Smoothie like sour with oranges, papaya and mango blend. Rich sweet and refreshing sour combo with citrusy and earthy profile. Pure fun!Everything is the same. The main goal is to provide you with a real smoothie like feeling. Hope you will enjoy!Contains unfermented fruit. Drink fresh. Don't age. Gently rotate can few times before you open it for best experience.This is why we brew!

name: Smoothiesh: ...Llamagini
text: And the answer is here!In our last smoothiesh, the cool looking Llama asked a question: "What do you call a fast llama?" and 3 osteriches answered - Llamagini!Our 4th smoothie like sour from 'Smoothiesh' serie brings out 4 different fruits: raspberry, blueberry, blackberry and strawberry.It's super mega heavily loaded with fruits, you will have breakfast in you glass. Deliciously sick!And the color and texture is just...amazing.Bon apetit!Contains unfermented fruit. Drink fresh. Don't age.Gently rotate can few times before you open it for best experience.This is why we brew!

name: Smoothiesh: What Did the Pig Say On the Warm Summer's Day?
text: What did the pig say on the warm summer's day?' is our first smootie sour in a new sour series - Smoothiesh.  It's super mega heavily loaded with strawberries and bananas. Smooth, thick and fluffy, sweet and sour. Wonderfully rich and bold! An ideal choice for a morning breakfast, or first hangover meal, a second breakfast or even brunch, an aperatizer before lunch, two just for lunch, for dessert after meal or just snack between second lunch, early dinner, real dinner, supper, or midnight snack. Did we say 'anytime' already?Grab our goofy giraffe and have fun.This is why we brew!

name: Fiddler's Green
text: Thick, thick and thick. A masive stout with big body and very smooth taste. Complex base and interesting process managed to enhance dark and milk chocolate, sweet caramel, hint of coffee and big tastefull liqueurish feeling. A Beauty.Fiddler's Green is an after-life where there is perpetual mirth, a fiddle that never stops playing, and dancers who never tire.That's was our inspiration for this outrages heavyweight pearl.This is a dessert beer, going well with chocolate cakes, dark cookies and other sweetish stuff.Suitable for aging.

name: Croatian Imperial Stout
text: Our 100th brew!  Inspired by the dark delicacies that dot the Dalmatian coast – Figs, Carobs, Red wine oak - our thick, complex, satiating imperial stout harmoniously marries these ingredients to provide a perfect winter warmer. Roasted malts coalesce with notes of molasses, fig, espresso, dark chocolate, raisin, and dried fruits. High dextrin & lactose are behind the velvety smooth texture of our imperial stout. Its decadence is topped and rounded out with a 5 week conditioning with toasted oak from the local forests of Slavonia. 6 months of cold conditioning deep down within our cellar means we’ve done the hard work for you’

name: BA Prototype 2024: Bourbon Oak Blend
text: Our signature Prototype Imperial Stout that spent eighteen months in a blend of Kentucky bourbon barrels, developing layers of vanilla, dark chocolate, and oak complexity.

name: Ransiki Temptation
text: Collaboration with Taman Artisan chocolates. Produced using shells and parts of cocoa beans originating from the Ransiki region of Indonesia.

name: Pomalo
text: Imperial Hazelnut & Toffee Stout.Smooth, sweet, full bodied & decadent.

name: Imperial Coconut, Maple Syrup & Cacao Stout
text: Sweet & Smooth. Dark & Complex. A 4-way collab with friends from Mexico, Canada & USA

name: Requiem
text: During fermentation we added sour cherry pure for extra layer of flavours and complexity.Aged for 16 months in Woodford Reserve bourbon barrel, where also aged Martinique rum. Smooth, oily, complex, flavourfull.

name: Imperial Coconut & Rum Stout
text: Decadent dessert stout with coconut and gently spiced Jamaican rum.

name: Planina - Double Imperial Affogato Stout
text: Inspired by the Italian classic: Espresso, Cacao & Madagascan Vanilla

name: Imperial Affogato Stout
text: A luxurious, caramel laden imp stout base, drowned in cold brewed coffee, rested on cacao nibs, tonka and vanilla beans.

name: Moka Express
text: Huge body, oily and thick, chewy, but very smooth, obtained from as many as 14 different malts from which we extracted primarily a lot of chocolate and nutty flavors, with some liqueur.However, what made this creation stand out was the brilliant fresh coffee beans. This time we decided to use the fantastic 'Sítio Canaa' coffee from the iconic Danish coffee roaster La Cabra. This beauty, grown by Denilson Corsi da Silva on his Brazilian farm 'Cerrado Mineiro', is characterized most by a sweet milk chocolate aroma, with some soft fruitiness.We are very excited that we managed to transfer these wonderful notes to our #MokaExpress. Coffeeish' gem. Enjoy.

name: Double Imperial Affogato Stout
text: Huge pastry stout inspired by the Italian classic. Laden with cold-brew Espresso, Cacao Nibs, Tonka Beans, Milk Sugar and Madagascan Vanilla pods

name: Imperial Hazelnut & Coffee Stout
text: Smooth and silky with toasted Hazelnuts, local freshly roasted Coffee and Cacao Nibs

name: Imperial Almond & Coffee Stout
text: Decadent desert stout laced with coffee and almond aromas rested on heaps of cacao nibs.

name: Cherna Zorya
text: Aged on Ethiopia Sidamo (100% Arabica). Intense coffee aroma, roasted beans, chocolate, mild bitterness and sourness of coffee. Full-bodied, dense like an espresso.

name: Imperial Coffee, Caramel & Chocolate Stout
text: Rich and robust with dark Caramel notes. Rested on Cacao Nibs. Made with Hercules Brewery

name: Imperial Salted Caramel & Chocolate Biscuit Stout
text: Deep layers of rich caramel, chocolate, and biscuit aromas combine with a full-bodied salted imperial milk stout.

name: For Goodness Shake
text: It's something new!It's super delicious!It's small batch of pastry coffee cream Imperial stout.We added bourbon barrel aged maple syrup from Vermont, and La Cabra's Tunsisa, an Ethiopian coffee beans.Than we twisted this impy with coconut cream and condensed milk to add beautiful creaminess and crazy good flavors! For goodness sake, I mean... for goodness shake - this is absolutely fantastic.Contains lactose. Don't age. Keep in a refrigerator. Drink fresh. For best experience, gently rotate the can few times before you open it.THIS IS WHY WE BREW!

name: Imperial Chocolate, Almond & Coconut Stout
text: Melt in the mouth Desert Stout with 10 different malts. Rich, sweet & smooth

name: Imperial Hazelnut & Toffee Stout
text: Sweet toffee and hazelnut flavours layered on top of an enormous imperial chocolate milk stout base.

name: Blackheart King
text: Say hello to our new pastry imperial stout!Brewerd with vanilla and conditioned on vanilla and coconut.This is a extra thick, dense body stout and yet still smooth with 10.2 abv. Like  a real liquid chocolate bar with coconuts. Pastry stuff' indeed.Very limited edition, extra small batch. This is why we brew!

name: Imperial Banoffee Pie Stout
text: Salted Caramel, Rich chocolate, and caramelised bananas spread all over a rich biscuit base.  In a glass!

name: BA Prototype 2024: Southern Nutty Blend
text: At 12% ABV, this Imperial Stout unfolds waves of dark chocolate complemented by the rich notes of fresh nuts. A time spent in barrels, alongside walnuts and hazelnuts, created a fusion of roasted malt and nutty complexity.

name: Tama - Imperial Salted Caramel & Chocolate Biscuit Stout
text: Rich, sweet and indulgent on a milk stout biscuit base

name: Imperial Coconut & Vanilla Stout
text: Smooth and decadent Imperial Stout, brewed with fresh coconut and conditioned on vanilla.

name: Imperial Maraschino Cherry & Tonka Bean Stout
text: An enormous imperial desert stout brewed in collaboration with our friends at Tanker.  Deep and complex malt combine with marino cherrys, cacao, vanilla and spicy tonka beans.

name: Imperial Raspberry & Coconut Stout
text: Sweet pastry stout overflowing with chocolate, raspberry, and coconut.

name: Chokos
text: We went double down on creativity with this beer! It's a collab with Brk Lee brewery, but it's also a beer-design partnership that bridges the cities of Rijeka and Zagreb, creating a Choco-Coco Milk Stout.

name: BA Prototype 2023: Martinique Blend
text: Aged for 18 months in Rhum J.M. rum barrels, this Prototype Russian Imperial Stout explodes with aromas of dark chocolate and rich vanilla.

name: BA Prototype 2023: Kentucky Blend
text: This version of Prototype RIS was aged for 18 months in both Woodford Reserve and Wild Turkey bourbon barrels and then blended for a harmonious intensity. Expect woody notes with layers of dark chocolate, and baking spice.

name: Prototype 2021
text: The first heavy-hitter in our portfolio. Traditional Russian Imperial Stout.

name: RIS
text: As big as Russia, as lavish as a palace, as complex as court intrigues and as mighty as a Tzar, the Russian Imperial Stout beer style originated as a love statement to Empress Catherine the Great. Seduced by that very style, we brewed this beer with a hefty amount of alcohol and rich chocolate and coffee aromas from dark malts.Truly Imperial!

name: 13th Omen
text: Lucky by choice.

name: HYPERBOLA
text: Hyperbole, from a Greek word meaning "excess," is a figure of speech that uses extreme exaggeration to make a point or show emphasis. Strong, dark, mature beer to make a point - meet our Russian Imperial Stour "Hyperbole"  y2/a2-x2/b2=1

name: Balaur
text: Barrel aged one year in whiskey barrels.

name: Paria Temptation
text: Collab with artisan chocolaterie Taman. RIS made with Criollo and Trinitario cocoa beans from Paria peninsula. Chocolate aroma is accentuated and the flavors are rounded off with malted caramel. Full body, sweet finish.

name: Russian Pirate
text: Russian Pirate has aged for over a year in barrels that used to store rum. It is full-bodied with warm flavors of chocolate, cocoa, molasses and with a fair 9% alcohol.

name: Nochnica
text: Barrel aged, chocolate in the aroma, pleasant smell of roasted coffee, biscuits, vanilla, wooden barrel. Full body, thick and sweet.

name: Duality 10: Merlot
text: Mixed Fermentation Sour Ale (wine yeast and oak barrel) with Merlot Pommace
